sloka: निवेद्य रामाय तदा महात्मनेमहा अभिषेकम् कपि वाहनी पतिः ।रुमाम् च भार्याम् उपलभ्य वीर्यवान्अवाप राज्यम् त्रिदश अधिपो यथा ॥४-२६-४२॥
transliteration: nivedya rāmāya tadā mahātmanemahā abhiṣekam kapi vāhanī patiḥ ।rumām ca bhāryām upalabhya vīryavānavāpa rājyam tridaśa adhipo yathā ॥4-26-42॥

translations.english: Then the valorous lord of the vanara host, having announced the great consecration to the great-souled Rama and regained his wife Ruma, obtained the kingdom as the lord of the thirty gods obtains his.
